title: Monday Quick Tip
subtitle: Who takes the shot
hook: Your team gets a penalty kick. Who takes it?
intro: The whole team looks at you.
One player is raising a hand.
statement: Who takes the shot sends a message to the team.
q1: Do you pick your most reliable shooter —
q2: or rotate the chance among players who want it?
q3: How will the player feel if they miss?
t1: There is no single right way. But kids grow
t2: when they get chances to take the big shot.
cta: Coaches — who takes your penalty kicks?
ctaLines: Best shooter. A rotation. Whoever was fouled.
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Your team gets a penalty kick. Who takes it?
The whole team looks at you. One player is raising a hand.
Who takes the shot sends a message to the team.
The most reliable shooter or a rotation. Every team is different.
Who takes your penalty kicks? Share your habit in the comments.
